title: 幌を広げたベビーカーの静的プロップ
description: 公園、歩道や公共施設の待合スペースに配置する、幌を広げた汎用ベビーカー。実際に開いた幌と内側、布地の座面と斜めの背、ハーネス、折り畳み部の丸い継手、下部収納バスケット、前方旋回キャスター、後輪と押し手を造形しています。子供、人、荷物や玩具は含みません。固定の外観用モデルで、折り畳み・走行・ブレーキ・拘束や子供の使用を支える機能はなく、荷重定格や安全認証はありません。育児用品の設計や操作指示ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.606 × 1.114 × 0.897 m、13,944三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A generic stroller with extended open canopy for park, sidewalk and public waiting-area scenes. Features a genuinely open canopy with visible inside, textile seat and reclined back, harness, round folding joints, lower storage basket, front swivel casters, rear wheels and push handle. No child, person, luggage or toys are included. Fixed appearance geometry has no folding, rolling, braking, restraint or child-use function, load rating or safety certification. It is not a childcare product design or operating guidance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.606 × 1.114 × 0.897 m; 13,944 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
